suggest-8-pattern-detectors.description: Aspect suggestion uses 8 ordered regex pattern detectors with confidence-based priority

lore-inferred-edge-weight-0.3.name: Lore Inferred Edge Weight 0.3
lore-inferred-edge-weight-0.3.description: Edges inferred from shared lore entries use weight 0.3 and origin 'learned'

lore-link-materialization-idempotent.name: Lore Link Materialization Idempotent
lore-link-materialization-idempotent.description: Lore link materialization is idempotent — clears all existing links before rebuilding

agent-default-model-assignments.name: Agent Default Model Assignments
agent-default-model-assignments.description: Default model assignments — architect/security=opus, reviewer=sonnet, builder/tester=haiku

agent-token-estimates.name: Agent Token Estimates
agent-token-estimates.description: Per-agent token usage estimates for cost preview (builder is the largest at 10K-50K)

orchestration-cost-pricing.name: Orchestration Cost Pricing
orchestration-cost-pricing.description: Orchestration cost preview uses its own pricing table (opus $15/$75, sonnet $3/$15, haiku $0.25/$1.25)

builder-fresh-context-principle.name: Builder Fresh Context Principle
builder-fresh-context-principle.description: Builder agents must never carry assumptions from previous tasks — each runs in a clean context

reviewer-two-stage-protocol.name: Reviewer Two Stage Protocol
reviewer-two-stage-protocol.description: Reviewer must pass spec compliance (stage 1) before code quality review (stage 2) with minimum 3 findings

tool-dispatch-prefix-routing.name: Tool Dispatch Prefix Routing
tool-dispatch-prefix-routing.description: Tool dispatch uses name prefix matching — each tool family is routed by its paradigm_ prefix

context-tools-skip-tracking.name: Context Tools Skip Tracking
context-tools-skip-tracking.description: Context tools (paradigm_context_*, paradigm_session_*) do not call trackToolCall to avoid infinite recursion

recovery-preamble-first-response.name: Recovery Preamble First Response
recovery-preamble-first-response.description: Recovery preamble and plugin update notice are prepended to the first tool response only

fuzzy-search-max-distance-3.name: Fuzzy Search Max Distance 3
fuzzy-search-max-distance-3.description: Fuzzy symbol search uses a maximum Levenshtein distance of 3 and returns at most 5 results

route-similarity-threshold-0.6.name: Route Similarity Threshold 0.6
route-similarity-threshold-0.6.description: Gate suggestions require a minimum route similarity score of 0.6 to match portal.yaml patterns

ripple-depth-clamp-1-to-5.name: Ripple Depth Clamp 1 To 5
ripple-depth-clamp-1-to-5.description: Ripple analysis depth is clamped to the range 1-5 (user cannot request depth 0 or >5)

reindex-11-stage-pipeline.name: Reindex 11 Stage Pipeline
reindex-11-stage-pipeline.description: Reindex rebuilds artifacts in 11 steps — scan-index.json, navigator.yaml, flow-index.json, aspect-graph.db, lore links, persona index, protocol index, integrity check, component anchors, purpose health, cross-file validation

aspect-graph-build-non-fatal.name: Aspect Graph Build Non Fatal
aspect-graph-build-non-fatal.description: Aspect graph build failure during reindex is non-fatal — it is caught and silently skipped

stdio-transport-only.name: Stdio Transport Only
stdio-transport-only.description: The MCP server uses stdio transport exclusively (no HTTP, no WebSocket)

background-reindex-on-mutation.name: Background Reindex On Mutation
background-reindex-on-mutation.description: Purpose/portal mutations trigger a non-blocking background reindex to keep static files in sync

resource-uri-paradigm-scheme.name: Resource Uri Paradigm Scheme
resource-uri-paradigm-scheme.description: All MCP resources must use the paradigm:// URI scheme — unknown schemes throw an error

~provider-cascade.name: ~provider Cascade
~provider-cascade.description: Agent providers are tried in priority order (claude > claude-code-teams > claude-code > cursor-cli > claude-cli > manual) until one is available; manual is always the ultimate fallback

~budget-enforced.name: ~budget Enforced
~budget-enforced.description: All orchestrations enforce token and cost budgets at global (default 500K tokens, $5 USD) and per-agent levels; exceeding triggers budget-exceeded signal and halts agent

~ide-adapter-pattern.name: ~ide Adapter Pattern
~ide-adapter-pattern.description: IDE instruction files are generated from shared base helpers in a fixed section ordering; each adapter overrides detection and generation methods for its target IDE

~audit-required.name: ~audit Required
~audit-required.description: All orchestrations MUST emit audit events recording agent spawning, budget usage, and result merging

~log-level-env-resolution.name: ~log Level Env Resolution
~log-level-env-resolution.description: Log level resolves from LOG_LEVEL env var first; if unset, defaults to debug in development and info in production (NODE_ENV=production)

~format-auto-detection.name: ~format Auto Detection
~format-auto-detection.description: Log format resolves from PARADIGM_LOG_FORMAT env var (json forces JSON); otherwise defaults to JSON in production, pretty in development; pretty format uses ANSI color codes per level (gray/cyan/yellow/red)

~symbol-auto-prefix-normalization.name: ~symbol Auto Prefix Normalization
~symbol-auto-prefix-normalization.description: Symbol loggers auto-prefix symbols with their type prefix if not already present — component() adds

~correlation-async-local-storage.name: ~correlation Async Local Storage
~correlation-async-local-storage.description: Correlation tracking uses Node.js AsyncLocalStorage to propagate correlation IDs through async call chains without explicit parameter threading; IDs are UUIDs from crypto.randomUUID

~symbol-filter-env-var.name: ~symbol Filter Env Var
~symbol-filter-env-var.description: PARADIGM_SYMBOLS env var provides comma-separated prefix filter (e.g., "#,^") to restrict which symbol types emit logs; null means all symbols pass

v2-symbols-only.name: V2 Symbols Only
v2-symbols-only.description: UI only renders v2 symbol types (#, $, ^, !, ~)

responsive-layout.name: Responsive Layout
responsive-layout.description: UI adapts to viewport size for all layout modes

~visual-tag-inference-patterns.name: ~visual Tag Inference Patterns
~visual-tag-inference-patterns.description: Component names are matched against 30+ regex patterns (button, form, modal, nav, etc.) to infer visual tags for image-to-code mapping

~scan-index-schema-version-1-0-0.name: ~scan Index Schema Version 1 0 0
~scan-index-schema-version-1-0-0.description: Scan index $meta.version is always '1.0.0'; tracked separately from paradigmVersion

~purpose-schema-passthrough.name: ~purpose Schema Passthrough
~purpose-schema-passthrough.description: PurposeItemSchema uses Zod passthrough() to allow extra fields (tags, location, uses, used-by, etc.) without validation errors

~purpose-file-depth-sort.name: ~purpose File Depth Sort
~purpose-file-depth-sort.description: .purpose files are sorted by directory depth (shallowest first) for correct parent-to-child aggregation

~purpose-glob-ignore-patterns.name: ~purpose Glob Ignore Patterns
~purpose-glob-ignore-patterns.description: findPurposeFiles ignores node_modules, dist, and .git directories

~symbol-blocklist-framework-aliases.name: ~symbol Blocklist Framework Aliases
~symbol-blocklist-framework-aliases.description: $lib, $env, $app, $service-worker, $virtual, $schema, $ref, $id, $type are blocked from symbol extraction to avoid false positives from SvelteKit/Vite/JSON

~symbol-ref-pattern-letter-guard.name: ~symbol Ref Pattern Letter Guard
~symbol-ref-pattern-letter-guard.description: Cross-reference regex requires first char after prefix to be a letter (prevents matching $420, $0)

~anchor-parse-formats.name: ~anchor Parse Formats
~anchor-parse-formats.description: Code anchors support four formats: file.ts, file.ts:15, file.ts:15-20, file.ts:15,25,30

~safe-expression-evaluator-no-eval.name: ~safe Expression Evaluator No Eval
~safe-expression-evaluator-no-eval.description: Expression evaluator uses custom tokenizer + recursive descent parser; never uses eval()

~one-time-prize-tracking.name: ~one Time Prize Tracking
~one-time-prize-tracking.description: One-time prizes are tracked per entity ID and skipped if already fired for that entity

~watcher-reconnect-5s.name: ~watcher Reconnect 5s
~watcher-reconnect-5s.description: WebSocket watcher reconnects after 5 seconds on close (dev mode only)

~gate-guard-fail-modes.name: ~gate Guard Fail Modes
~gate-guard-fail-modes.description: GateGuard decorator supports three failure modes: throw, return-null, return-false

~validator-production-disabled.name: ~validator Production Disabled
~validator-production-disabled.description: Portal validator logging is disabled in production unless PORTAL_VALIDATION=true

~validator-max-stored-results-100.name: ~validator Max Stored Results 100
~validator-max-stored-results-100.description: Gate results store keeps at most 100 entries to prevent memory leaks

~viewer-ws-port-42196.name: ~viewer Ws Port 42196
~viewer-ws-port-42196.description: WebSocket server defaults to port 42196 (marathon + 1); UI defaults to 42195

~viewer-cors-wildcard.name: ~viewer Cors Wildcard
~viewer-cors-wildcard.description: API responses set Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for cross-origin access

~viewer-sdk-ui-client-routing.name: ~viewer Sdk Ui Client Routing
~viewer-sdk-ui-client-routing.description: WebSocket clients are routed to SDK or UI handler based on URL path (/ui prefix)

~portal-yaml-version-required.name: ~portal Yaml Version Required
~portal-yaml-version-required.description: Gate config must have a "version" field; parsing throws if missing

~gate-id-kebab-case.name: ~gate Id Kebab Case
~gate-id-kebab-case.description: Gate, lock, and prize IDs must match kebab-case pattern /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$/

~lock-mode-default-all.name: ~lock Mode Default All
~lock-mode-default-all.description: Lock mode defaults to "all" when not specified; only "all" and "any" are valid

~portal-glob-ignore-patterns.name: ~portal Glob Ignore Patterns
~portal-glob-ignore-patterns.description: findGateFiles ignores node_modules, dist, and .git directories

~portal-dev-ports-marathon.name: ~portal Dev Ports Marathon
~portal-dev-ports-marathon.description: Default dev ports are 42195 (visualizer, marathon 42.195km) and 42196 (watcher)

~gates-portals-key-alias.name: ~gates Portals Key Alias
~gates-portals-key-alias.description: Parser supports both 'gates' and legacy 'portals' keys for backward compatibility

~lock-requires-keys.name: ~lock Requires Keys
~lock-requires-keys.description: A lock with zero keys is a validation error (can never be opened)

~flow-gates-must-exist.name: ~flow Gates Must Exist
~flow-gates-must-exist.description: Flow gate references must point to declared gate IDs; unknown refs are errors

~strict-equality-warning.name: ~strict Equality Warning
~strict-equality-warning.description: Key expressions using == instead of === emit a warning suggesting strict equality

~solo-vs-faceted-modes.name: ~solo Vs Faceted Modes
~solo-vs-faceted-modes.description: Orchestrator supports two modes — solo (single generalist agent, uses opus) and faceted (multi-agent with role-specific prompts); default is faceted

~default-agent-model-assignments.name: ~default Agent Model Assignments
~default-agent-model-assignments.description: Default model tier per agent role — architect/security use opus, reviewer uses sonnet, builder/tester use haiku

~confidence-threshold-3-match.name: ~confidence Threshold 3 Match
~confidence-threshold-3-match.description: Agent matcher confidence levels — high requires 3+ matches or multiple match types, medium requires 2, low is 1

~fresh-context-principle.name: ~fresh Context Principle
~fresh-context-principle.description: Builder prompt enforces Fresh Context Principle — each builder task runs in separate clean context with no assumptions carried from prior tasks

~reviewer-two-stage-minimum-3.name: ~reviewer Two Stage Minimum 3
~reviewer-two-stage-minimum-3.description: Reviewer prompt uses two-stage review (spec compliance then code quality) with Stage 1 blocking Stage 2; every review must produce at least 3 categorized findings

~model-discovery-order.name: ~model Discovery Order
~model-discovery-order.description: Model discovery follows a 3-tier fallback — API providers first, then remote manifest (cached 7 days), then hardcoded presets

~provider-cascade-order.name: ~provider Cascade Order
~provider-cascade-order.description: Provider cascade order is claude, claude-code-teams, claude-code, cursor-cli, claude-cli, manual — manual is always-available ultimate fallback

~task-classification-priority.name: ~task Classification Priority
~task-classification-priority.description: Task type classification priority is analysis > documentation > bugfix > refactor > feature (default); complexity scored from symbol count, word count, prefix diversity, gate/flow symbols, affected files

~budget-defaults-500k-5usd-80pct.name: ~budget Defaults 500k 5usd 80pct
~budget-defaults-500k-5usd-80pct.description: Default budget limits are 500K tokens, $5.00 USD max cost, warning at 80% usage; enforced at global and per-agent levels

~cost-estimation-per-million.name: ~cost Estimation Per Million
~cost-estimation-per-million.description: Model pricing is per-million tokens — opus $15/$75, sonnet $3/$15, haiku $0.25/$1.25 (input/output); cost estimation uses complexity multipliers (low 0.6x, medium 1.0x, high 1.5x)

~context-role-specific-includes.name: ~context Role Specific Includes
~context-role-specific-includes.description: Context builder uses role-specific include/exclude patterns — architect gets specs and .purpose files (excludes src), builder gets src and tests (excludes specs), security gets portal.yaml and auth directories

~flow-mermaid-generation.name: ~flow Mermaid Generation
~flow-mermaid-generation.description: Flow validator generates Mermaid flowchart TD diagrams — gates as diamonds, actions as rectangles, signals as rounded rectangles; includes deny paths for gates and color-coded class definitions

~portal-language-agnostic-grep.name: ~portal Language Agnostic Grep
~portal-language-agnostic-grep.description: Portal compliance uses grep-based language-agnostic pattern matching to find gate references across ts/js/py/go files; searches for ^symbol patterns and function-based checks (checkGate, requireGate, @Gate)

~audit-log-yaml-per-orchestration.name: ~audit Log Yaml Per Orchestration
~audit-log-yaml-per-orchestration.description: Audit logs are stored as YAML files in .paradigm/orchestrations/ with date-prefixed filenames; each file contains full agent details, token counts, costs, and artifacts

~background-accept-reject-workflow.name: ~background Accept Reject Workflow
~background-accept-reject-workflow.description: Background orchestrations follow a pending/running/completed/accepted/rejected lifecycle; only completed orchestrations can be accepted or rejected, rejection can optionally clean up created files

habits-loader.name: Habits Loader
habits-loader.description: Habits engine — 5-step merge loader (seeds → global yaml → global .habit → project yaml → project .habit), validation, and individual .habit file support

habits-types.name: Habits Types
habits-types.description: Habit type definitions — HabitDefinition, HabitCheck, HabitCategory, HabitTrigger, HabitSeverity, check type enums

~provider-api-key-requirements.name: ~provider Api Key Requirements
~provider-api-key-requirements.description: Each provider has specific environment detection — claude requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, claude-code requires CLAUDE_CODE=1 or TERM_PROGRAM=claude, cursor-cli requires Cursor IDE environment, claude-cli checks claude command in PATH

~manual-always-available-fallback.name: ~manual Always Available Fallback
~manual-always-available-fallback.description: Manual provider is always available (isAvailable returns true unconditionally) and creates file-based handoff tasks in .paradigm/handoffs/ and .paradigm/tasks/ for human execution

~adapter-section-ordering.name: ~adapter Section Ordering
~adapter-section-ordering.description: All IDE adapters emit sections in a shared order — header, overview, symbol system, terminal guidance, navigation, MCP tools, workflow protocol, session recovery, checkpoints, logging rules, conventions, commit convention, update rules, scan protocol, footer; sections are only included if the config has relevant data

human-gated-transfer.name: Human Gated Transfer
human-gated-transfer.description: File transfers always require explicit human approval (unless auto-approved in trust config)

hard-deny-list.name: Hard Deny List
hard-deny-list.description: Certain file patterns (.env, *.key, *.pem, credentials) are always blocked regardless of approval

~stop-hook-8-compliance-checks.name: ~stop Hook 8 Compliance Checks
~stop-hook-8-compliance-checks.description:
Stop hook blocks agent completion unless 8 checks pass:
(1) source files modified without .purpose updates (threshold 2+),
(2) modified directories missing .purpose files entirely,
(3) route patterns added without portal.yaml,
(4) aspect anchor files that no longer exist,
(5) per-directory .purpose freshness via .pending-review,
(6) aspect coverage advisory,
(7) lore entry expected for 3+ source file sessions,
(8) blocking habits not satisfied

~pre-tool-use-auto-reindex.name: ~pre Tool Use Auto Reindex
~pre-tool-use-auto-reindex.description: PreToolUse hook intercepts Bash calls matching git commit patterns and automatically runs paradigm reindex before the commit proceeds; never blocks the tool call

~post-tool-use-advisory.name: ~post Tool Use Advisory
~post-tool-use-advisory.description: PostToolUse hook fires after Edit/Write tool calls and emits an advisory reminder when source files are edited without nearby .purpose coverage; advisory only, never blocks
